notes: Added missing stories to complete schema, UI, and testing coverage for explainability layer.

stories.title: Define Explainability Schema Contract
stories.description: Design and implement a standardized explainability schema (Pydantic models) that includes source, meaning, and limitations fields for each evaluation signal, ensuring consistency across provider and clinical trial data.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Signals
stories.description: Update MessageBubble and chat rendering logic to display explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) in a clear, user-friendly format alongside evaluation results.

stories.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for explainability mapping logic and integration tests validating that API responses include correct explainability fields for provider and clinical trial scenarios.

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict schema validation and reuse existing facade patterns to avoid inconsistent explainability outputs.
